bayts.text: The blessing of Him to Whom Existence and beginningless Eternity are necessarily due makes our services grow.
Glory be to the Possessor of Permanence and of Dissimilarity (from all creatures), He Who has led security to me without opposition.
The kingdom of Him to Whom Self-Subsistence is necessary has led wonders to my whole being.
Praise belongs to Allah — exalted be He — alone, just as to Him (belong) these five (qualities) and Oneness.
(Praise belongs) to Him to Whom belong Power and Will, Knowledge, together with Life: (His is) the worship.
To Him to Whom belongs Hearing, as to Him Sight, together with Speech, (Lord) of everything, and He has given help.
He — exalted be He — is Powerful, Willing, Knowing, Living: He is the Unique.
Allah, our Lord, is Hearing and Seeing, and Speaking; and He has bestowed palaces.
Never have non-existence, contingency or annihilation come near Him from Whom (comes) the Discourse (the Qurʾān).
The Lord of creatures has no likeness (to them), nor need; rather, to Him belong those who resemble (one another).
My praise (goes) to an Everlasting One exalted above multiplicity, begetting, origin and idle play.
Our King: neither incapacity nor constraint has come near Him, and no slumber overtakes Him.
I praise Him toward Whom ignorance, death and deafness have not come, and He has already spared me anguish.
He has benefited me toward Whom blindness and muteness have not come: and what an excellent Judge!
The bringing into existence of every possible (thing) and the leaving of it (in non-being), admit it for Him Who, by grace, has spared you associationism.
There is no lord but Him; He is free of need of all else, and everything other than Him has need of Him.
Our Messenger, our Prophet, Muḥammad, is a servant and a messenger whom the Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad) has chosen.
Truthfulness, drawn to him together with Trustworthiness and the Conveying (of the message) to us, has protected him from lying.
He Who made treachery and concealment unlawful for him leads my service to the one who holds the Seal (of prophethood).
Muḥammad is a human (created) by Him to Whom beginningless Eternity belongs, like His messengers, (yet) set foremost: be (you) devoted to service!
